learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the basic concepts from the area of automatic control for continuous systems.
Solve tasks like determination of mathematical models, drawing basic characteristic, checking the stability, synthesis methods.

syllabus_topics: L-transformation and its properties. Solving differential equations.
Analytical identification - mechanical systems, hydro systems, electrical circuits.
Mathematical models of continuous linear dynamic systems.
Continuous linear close-loop control system and its properties.
Continuous conventional controllers and their properties.
The stability of continuous linear control system and criteria for its verification.
The choice of conventional continuous controller and its setting.
Chosen methods for control systems synthesis.
